decisions.reason: The existing message-684 MODIFY already records the first-mint exception and reconciles visible totals as one ticket for each primary mint after Mint #1.

The accepted exception concerns the already-completed first mint with no available recipient; it does not necessarily change the FAQ's forward-looking explanation of referrals and no-referral allocation.
The existing message-684 MODIFY already states that Mint #1 receives no ticket when no earlier NFT exists for random selection.
The existing message-684 MODIFY already excludes the one-off first mint without a referral commission from displayed commission reconciliation.
The first-mint ticket issuance exception does not change the Small Block draw amount, cadence, funding, recurrence, or eligibility rules.
The metadata requirement remains valid unchanged: ticket counters must remain accurate, but its current state does not assert that Mint #1 must possess a ticket.
The existing message-684 MODIFY already records that no affiliate commission is awarded for Mint #1 when no earlier NFT exists; the standard $15 split remains unchanged for later mints.
The About-page process copy describes the continuing no-referral allocation flow; the client characterized Mint #1 as a completed one-off with no forward impact.
The existing message-684 MODIFY already records that Mint #1 receives no commission when no existing NFT holder is available.
The one-off first-mint accounting exception does not alter the Mission page's general referral, prize, or project-purpose copy.
The source decision concerns whether Mint #1 generated a ticket and commission, not how a selected prize winner receives a payout.
The first-mint reward exception does not change Transak, accepted fiat methods, wallet requirements, conversion, or automatic mint behavior.
